summary: Digits as raised keys, for a PIN shown as dots or an amount in its currency. The keyboard types into it too once it has focus.

props.name: value
props.description: The typed digits, controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The typed digits on first render, uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the digits whenever they change.

props.name: length
props.description: How many digits a PIN takes.

props.name: currency
props.description: The currency an amount is in, as an ISO code.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formats the amount's grouping, decimal mark and currency sign.

props.name: label
props.description: The line over the display, and the keypad's accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.description: A PIN of a fixed length, shown as dots, or an amount with its currency.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the keys. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
